title: Change & Go-to-Market Commercial Manager – D2C
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?</strong></p> <p>Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.</p></div><p><strong>Role overview:</strong></p> <p>Sony Interactive Entertainment (PlayStation) is seeking a Change & GTM Commercial Manager to shape and deliver strategic e-commerce initiatives at global scale.  This role goes beyond project delivery: you will turn customer, market, and trading insights into clear commercial strategies and own the end-to-end go-to-market lifecycle - from opportunity sizing and value proposition through launch, adoption, retention, and continuous optimization. You will help improve how players discover, evaluate, purchase, and engage with PlayStation products and services across the Direct to Consumer (D2C) business. You will partner with Product, Engineering, Merchandising, Marketing, Analytics, Data Science, Finance, Legal, and Operations to deliver measurable customer and commercial value. </p> <p>This role requires a commercially minded, data-savvy operator who can frame ambiguous problems, work hands-on with data, influence strategic choices, and translate insight into execution with pace and agility. </p> <p><strong>What you'll be doing:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Shape e-commerce and GTM strategy - define the customer problem, size the opportunity, identify priority segments, and shape the value proposition, market sequencing, channel approach, and commercial roadmap.</li> <li>Drive analytical decision-making - analyse customer journeys, growth funnels, trading performance, and behavioural data to identify opportunities, diagnose performance gaps, and recommend clear actions.</li> <li>Build commercial cases and KPI frameworks - forecast and monitor outcomes including traffic, acquisition, conversion, basket size and average order value, purchase frequency, repeat purchase, LTV, and incremental revenue; use the evidence to guide investment and prioritization choices.</li> <li>Embed experimentation and personalization - partner with Product, Marketing, Analytics, and Data Science to design A/B tests, apply segmentation and predictive insights, and improve customer relevance and conversion.</li> <li>Own the full GTM lifecycle - connect commercial strategy to launch planning, customer activation, market readiness, adoption, retention, learning, and continuous optimization.</li> <li>Create performance visibility - build dashboards, decision-ready reporting, and review rhythms that turn data into recommendations, owners, and measurable performance improvements.</li> <li>Lead cross-functional orchestration and change - align global teams around customer outcomes, commercial goals, decisions, risks, dependencies, and business readiness; influence stakeholders through clear analysis and compelling narratives.</li> <li>Build scalable e-commerce playbooks - codify repeatable approaches for segmentation, proposition development, launch, experimentation, adoption, optimization, and transfer into business-as-usual ownership.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we're looking for:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Minimum 5 years of experience in management consulting, commercial strategy, e-commerce, digital commerce, growth, product, or GTM.</li> <li>Experience supporting transactional e-commerce, digital storefronts, D2C, technology, games, or entertainment is strongly preferred.</li> <li>Commercial modelling experience including opportunity sizing, forecasting, scenario analysis, business-case development, and assessing incremental revenue and customer value.</li> <li>Strong hands-on analytical capability including working with SQL, Tableau or similar BI tools, spreadsheets, KPI modelling, segmentation, funnel diagnostics, and AI-enabled analytical tools to generate actionable insights.</li> <li>Structured, hypothesis-driven problem-solving with the ability to bring clarity to complexity, test assumptions, and make practical recommendations from incomplete information.</li> <li>Experience with experimentation and optimization including A/B testing, test design, measurement, and using results to improve customer journeys and commercial performance.</li> <li>Strong e-commerce and customer-lifecycle understanding including digital storefronts, merchandising, offers and promotions, acquisition, conversion, checkout, basket value, repeat purchase, and personalized customer experiences.</li> <li>Proven ability to connect strategy to execution translating insight into clear choices, roadmaps, operating plans, and measurable outcomes.</li> <li>Strong cross-functional leadership with the communication, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills to influence product and business decisions at all levels.</li> <li>Experience leading business readiness and change for new digital capabilities, customer propositions, or commercial operating models.</li> <li>Product management or agile delivery experience is a plus. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Benefits</strong>:  </p> <ul> <li>Hybrid working </li> <li>Discretionary bonus opportunity </li> <li>Private Medical Insurance </li> <li>Dental Scheme </li> <li>25 days holiday per year </li> <li>On Site Gym </li> <li>Subsidised Café </li> <li>Free soft drinks </li> <li>On site bar </li> <li>Access to cycle garage and showers </li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p class="p1">Please note, Sony Interactive Entertainment conducts background checks at the offer stage for all new employees (which may include criminal background checks for some roles) and will need to process personal information to support these checks.</p> <p class="p1">Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice (where applicable) for more information about what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and your data protection rights.</p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity Statement:</strong></p> <p><em>Sony is an Equal Opportunity All persons will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender (including gender identity, gender expression and gender reassignment), race (including colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin), religion or belief, marital or civil partnership status, disability, age, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, trade union membership or membership in any other legally protected category.</em></p> <p><em>We strive to create an inclusive environment, empower employees and embrace diversity. We encourage everyone to respond. </em></p> <p><em>Sony Interactive Entertainment is a Fair Chance employer and qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records will be considered for employment.</em></p> <p> </p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Director, HR - Field Operations (Europe)
description: <p></p> <h2><strong>About the role: What's in the Box</strong></h2> <p>We are seeking a highly strategic, operational, and empathetic <strong>Senior Director, Human Resources – Field Operations (Europe)</strong>. In this critical leadership role, you will serve as the principal HR Business Partner to the SVP of Europe Operations while providing strategic direction and mentorship to a distributed team of Site HR professionals across our European fulfillment centers.</p> <p>You will bridge the gap between high-level operational strategy and on-the-ground employee experience. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, complex logistics or manufacturing environment, deeply understands European labor dynamics, and possesses the executive presence to challenge, coach, and partner with senior supply chain leaders.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do: The Recipe</strong></h2> <p><strong>Strategic Business Partnering</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as the dedicated HR Business Partner and trusted advisor to the SVP, Europe Operations, aligning human capital strategy with broader business and operational goals.</li> <li>Drive organizational design, workforce planning, and change management initiatives across the European operations network to ensure scalable, efficient, and agile structures.</li> <li>Coach and guide senior operational leadership on talent density, performance management, succession planning, and inclusive leadership.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Field HR Leadership & Team Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of Site HR Managers, Directors, and HRBPs embedded within our local fulfillment centers across multiple European countries (e.g., Germany, UK, Netherlands, France, Sweden, and Norway).</li> <li>Foster a cohesive, collaborative HR community across the region, ensuring best-in-class HR service delivery, consistency in policy application, and a unified company culture.</li> <li>Establish clear KPIs and metrics for the Field HR team, utilizing data to track retention, engagement, and operational efficiency.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Labor Relations, Works Council & Employee Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Architect a proactive employee relations strategy tailored to a blue-collar, high-volume operational workforce.</li> <li>Navigate complex European labor laws, partnering with local HR and legal teams to manage relationships with representation wherever applicable. </li> <li>Spearhead engagement and retention initiatives for frontline workers, ensuring a safe, inclusive, and rewarding workplace environment in our fulfillment centers.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Operational HR Excellence</strong></p> <ul> <li>Partner with Centers of Excellence (Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, Shared Service) to build customized programs for Field Operations, including competitive hourly wage structures, peak-season hiring strategies, and frontline leadership training.</li> <li>Standardize and optimize core HR processes across European sites while respecting local nuances and compliance requirements.</li> <li>Champion HelloFresh’s data-driven culture by analyzing employee feedback, turnover data, and absenteeism trends to implement targeted interventions.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring: The Ingredients </strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Experience:</strong> 12+ years of progressive HR leadership experience, with a minimum of 5 years leading HR functions in high-volume, multi-site Supply Chain, Fulfillment, Manufacturing, or Logistics environments.</li> <li><strong>Executive Partnering:</strong> Proven track record of operating as a strategic HRBP to C-suite or SVP-level operations leaders, with the ability to influence without authority and drive systemic change.</li> <li><strong>Pan-European Expertise:</strong> Deep understanding of European labor laws, compliance standards, and significant experience negotiating and collaborating with Works Councils and trade unions.</li> <li><strong>Leadership:</strong> Exceptional team leadership skills with experience managing, scaling, and empowering remote/distributed HR teams.</li> <li><strong>Analytical Acumen:</strong> A heavily data-driven approach to HR. You rely on metrics and analytics to identify root causes, build business cases, and measure the success of people initiatives.</li> <li><strong>Agility & Resilience:</strong> Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, and dynamic environment where ambiguity is common and speed is critical.</li> <li><strong>Languages:</strong> Business fluency in English is required; proficiency in an additional European language (e.g., German, Dutch, French) is highly preferred.</li> </ul> <p></p> <h2><strong>What we offer: The Toppings</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Shape the future of food:</strong> Play a key role in transforming how millions of people eat as we grow into a global food solutions company.</li> <li><strong>Drive transformational change:</strong> Your decisions will have a direct and immediate impact, helping to shape strategy, scale teams, and redefine leadership in a rapidly evolving business.</li> <li><strong>Build a global brand:</strong> Create deeper, more sustainable connections with our customers, putting them at the heart of every decision.</li> <li><strong>Benefit from long-term wealth creation:</strong> Your compensation is heavily weighted toward equity, directly aligning your personal success with the company's future through our Virtual Stock Option (VSO) and Restricted Stock Unit (RSU) plans.</li> <li><strong>Thrive in a high-performance environment:</strong> Work with ambitious, intellectually curious peers on a global scale, enjoying an environment built for empowerment and speed.</li> </ul> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Compliance Operations Analyst (KYB)
description: About Plasma Plasma is building the primary account for global money. Money used to belong to a country. Increasingly, it belongs to a person or business moving through many countries. People and businesses now earn, spend, save, hire and invest across borders. Traditional banks cannot serve this new world. Our first product, Plasma One, is a global money account: a place to receive, hold, send funds in seconds, earn yield and spend with a card in the local economy. Underneath is the Plasma network, built from first principles for stablecoin payments. Stablecoins make dollars faster, cheaper and more reliable to move. The opportunity is to become where all global money lands first: where income arrives, balances grow, payments move, businesses operate, and new financial products are built. The Team & Our Story We are a global team of founders, operators and engineers, obsessed with building the best products. We work at the cutting edge of financial innovation, using stablecoins to create tools for consumers and businesses. We operate with trust, clarity, and ambition: own your craft, move with urgency, contribute beyond your lane, back your teammates, debate rigorously, and keep raising the bar for what great means. Plasma is growing fast across international markets, and the businesses we work with need to get onboarded quickly and safely. We're growing the Customer Experience Team to keep up, and this role is fully focused on KYB (Know Your Business). You'll own the customer side of business onboarding, from the first document request to final approval. While we verify who a business is, who owns it and how it operates, you'll be the person they deal with. Our KYB playbook is still being built, so you won't just follow the process. You'll help write it, set the standards we hold ourselves to and shape the culture of the team as it grows. This isn't a 9 to 5. You'll need some flexibility on hours and the odd weekend shift to keep coverage strong and handle busy periods. We want someone who works hard, takes ownership without being asked, does well when things move fast and genuinely cares about what we're building. The role Own the KYB customer experience: Be the main point of contact for businesses going through onboarding. You will handle their queries across chat, email and support tooling, explain what we need and why, and take accountability for the quality and speed of every response. Run KYB reviews end to end: Collect and review company documents such as certificates of incorporation, registers of directors and shareholders, proof of address and ownership structures. Identify ultimate beneficial owners and check that what a business tells us matches what the documents show. Screen and assess risk: Carry out sanctions, PEP and adverse media checks on businesses and their key people, assess the nature of the business and its expected activity, and apply the right level of due diligence based on risk. Know when to escalate: Recognise higher-risk cases, complex ownership structures and red flags, and escalate them to Compliance with a clear, well-documented summary. Build the foundations: Many of our KYB templates, document checklists and customer guides do not exist yet. You will create them, so that customers know what to expect and the team works to one consistent standard. Work across teams: Partner closely with Compliance, Sales and Product so that the business onboarding journey is joined up, compliant and clear for the customer. Flag the most common issues so that our processes can be improved. We're a close team and everyone pitches in. When the wider CX team gets busy, we'll count on you to jump in and help out, and they'll do the same for you. The Bar 3 to 6 years of experience in KYB, onboarding or customer operations, ideally within fintech, payments or crypto. We will consider strong candidates from outside these sectors if the fit is right. Hands-on KYB knowledge. You understand how to verify a company, read corporate documents and work through ownership structures to identify beneficial owners and have good judgement on Risk. High attention to detail. You notice when a name, date or ownership percentage does not line up, and you keep clear records of what you checked and why. Someone who takes ownership & is organised under pressure. You do not wait to be told. When something is broken or missing, you fix it or flag it. You hold yourself to a high standard even when no one is watching.You can manage a queue of open cases, prioritise effectively and keep quality high when things are busy. Comfortable with ambiguity. This is an early-stage company. Processes will change, priorities will shift, and some days you will be figuring things out as you go. You see that as interesting rather than frustrating. Curious about crypto. You need to understand the basics of how stablecoins and digital assets work and be motivated to learn more. Many of the businesses we onboard operate in this space. Nice to have Experience onboarding crypto businesses , such as exchanges, VASPs, payment providers or OTC desks. Familiarity with AML regulations and frameworks , for example FATF guidance, EU AML directives or FinCEN requirements. Exposure to KYB and screening tools such as Sumsub, ComplyAdvantage, Persona, Middesk or similar. Experience with support tooling like Intercom or Zendesk in a live production environment. Experience in a startup or scale-up where you had to build or rebuild processes, not just follow them. A compliance qualification such as ICA or CAMS, or an interest in working towards one. Multilingual skills that could support business customers across our international markets What's in it for you Above-market salary for the level of the role, with token compensation. A beautiful London HQ with gym access and daily food, for those who thrive in an office environment. Visa sponsorship and relocation support if you're joining from abroad. Premium health insurance for you and your family, fully covered by Plasma. Monthly wellness budget, whether that's the gym, therapy, sauna, or massage. All the tools and tech you need to operate at your best. Real ownership and responsibility from day one, with your work shipping to hundreds of thousands of people, moving millions of dollars every day. Data Protection & Privacy We are committed to protecting the privacy and security of your personal data. Any personal information you provide during the recruitment process will be processed in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable local data protection laws. Compensation: £50K – £70K • Tokens Comp • £50K – £70K • Tokens Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Build trusted relationships with senior technical stakeholders at our customers. 2. Build the deployment organisation Design, recruit and lead Cosine's deployment function, including forward-deployed engineers, infrastructure specialists and technical project leaders. Establish the processes, tools and operating model needed to deliver multiple complex projects simultaneously. Build an exceptionally high-performing team, combining startup speed with enterprise-grade reliability. 3. title: Strategic Accounts Director
description: Job title: Strategic Accounts Director Location: London; full in-office working as default Start date: ASAP Reports to: Chief Commercial Officer Compensation: £80,000- £110,000 + Equity + Commission Application Deadline: Sunday 6th December at 23:59 UK Time ___________________________________________________________________________ Cosine at a glance Cosine is an applied AI research and engineering company building frontier AI models and autonomous software engineering systems. We're developing the UK's first sovereign frontier large language model, alongside specialised models trained for complex, high-stakes applications. Our technology can be deployed in highly secure environments, including fully air-gapped infrastructure, enabling organisations to adopt advanced AI without compromising control over their data or systems. We work with some of the world's most complex organisations across defence, financial services and other critical industries, helping them develop, customise and deploy AI capabilities that solve real operational problems. We're now looking to build a substantial presence in healthcare and life sciences. This role is based in our Hoxton office, five days a week, because close collaboration, fast feedback, and shared context matter for the problems we’re solving. ___________________________________________________________________________ The role Cosine is looking for a Strategic Accounts Director to lead commercial growth across a number of strategically important sectors, particularly those where data sensitivity, security and sovereignty create a compelling need for Cosine's AI capabilities. The role will combine new BD, enterprise sales, strategic account management and customer delivery. The successful candidate will be responsible not only for winning new customers, but for turning those customers into successful, long-term commercial partners of Cosine. ___________________________________________________________________________ Sector responsibilities The Account Director will have default commercial ownership of all sectors outside defence, healthcare and financial services, with an initial focus on: Legal and professional services Policing and law enforcement Secure government and regulatory bodies Critical National Infrastructure (CNI) Advanced manufacturing and engineering Research and higher education These responsibilities will evolve as Cosine grows, with specific sectors or accounts potentially transitioning to dedicated commercial leads as further hires are made. title: CNC Machinist
description: About Isembard Isembard is rebuilding industrial capacity through a connected network of factories. We bring skilled people, advanced machine tools and our own software, MasonOS, together to make precision components for aerospace, defence, energy and robotics. The role The parts you cut go into aircraft, defence systems, energy infrastructure and robots. This is a hands-on machining role at our Southwark factory in London, where you own your work from set-up to finished part rather than handing it down a line. The factory is growing quickly, so you will help improve how it runs rather than wait for someone else to. We run early and late shifts, and the package includes equity. Set up, prove out and run jobs on 3-axis and 5-axis machines to aerospace and defence standards. Edit and optimise programmes at the machine, and work with our CAM programmers on toolpaths. Choose fixturing, tooling and cutting parameters for aluminium, steels, titanium and nickel alloys. Hold tight tolerances and check your own work before it goes to inspection. Own cycle time and machine utilisation on your shift. What you bring Production experience setting and running high-end CNC machines such as Hermle, DMG Mori or Mazak. A record of holding tolerances of ±0.01 mm or tighter. A solid understanding of feeds, speeds, tooling and workholding, and confident reading of complex drawings and GD&T. Comfort working shifts in a fast-moving, high-ownership environment. Useful, not essential: CAM programming (hyperMILL, Fusion, Mastercam or similar), 5-axis simultaneous machining, probing or pallet systems, aerospace or defence work, or AS9100 familiarity. title: Account Executive, Commercial Named UK&I
description: <div class="content-intro"><div class="elementToProof"> <p>Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.</p> </div></div><p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p><strong><em>Lead at the forefront of AI & Data Resilience</em></strong></p> <p>At Veeam, we don’t just talk about the future of technology — we are actively shaping it. We are a global leader in data resilience, operating at the epicentre of the AI, cloud and security evolution. Our culture is built by forward-thinking technologists with heart: people who challenge convention, collaborate openly, and believe that great ideas can come from anywhere.</p> <p>Joining Veeam means being part of a business that combines the energy and agility of a start-up with the scale, credibility, and market leadership of a global technology powerhouse. We focus relentlessly on customer outcomes, empower our teams to own their destiny, and create an inclusive environment where every voice matters.</p> <p><strong><em>Why Veeam</em></strong></p> <p>Work at the heart of AI-driven data resilience, enjoy flexibility and outcome-based performance, and lead with autonomy in a globally recognized organization that invests deeply in its people, culture, and leadership.</p> <p><strong><em>The Opportunity</em></strong></p> <p>This is a pivotal growth role within Veeam’s UK & Ireland organization.</p> <p>As Account Executive, Commercial Named you will be responsible for a book of existing key FTSE 100 & 250 customers and a set of target private commercial named accounts to hunt and close net new logo acquisition. You will drive a daily rhythm to ensure in quarter execution and build forward pipeline. You will develop a clear point of view on the market and a constant curiosity to link corporate objectives and technology initiatives with customer and partners alike. You will set and manage the strategy for your Territory working with specialist teams in the UK & Ireland and Inside Sales and Sales Development teams based in Bucharest.</p> <p>Reporting to the Director of Commercial Named, UK & Ireland, you will play a central role in shaping how Veeam engages customers, partners, and the market — accelerating growth while building a culture of excellence, collaboration, and innovation.</p> <p><strong>What You'll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Set the vision for your UK & Ireland Commercial Named Territory</li> <li>Coordinate virtual, geographically distributed teams</li> <li>Drive disciplined sales execution across the full Veeam portfolio</li> <li>Accelerate growth in hybrid cloud and cloud-native environments</li> <li>Build executive-level relationships with senior stakeholders</li> <li>Challenge the status quo with bold, innovative ideas</li> <li>Partner with Channel, Hyperscalers, and System Integrators</li> </ul> <p><strong><em>What Success Looks Like</em></strong></p> <ul> <li>Sustained revenue growth and increased wallet share</li> <li>Strong operational excellence and predictable execution</li> <li>High-trust, high-performance sales culture</li> <li>Deep, long-term customer and partner relationships</li> <li>A future-ready, scalable Commercial Named Territory</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Bring</strong></p> <p>You are a seasoned Commercial Named Sales Account Executive with presence, energy, and ambition. You bring a proven track record of leading go-to-market strategy and execution in complex technology environments, deep understanding of data resilience and cloud ecosystems, and an inspirational style to coordinate and excite virtual teams.</p> <p><strong><em>Experience & Qualifications</em></strong></p> <ul> <li>Degree in business or technical discipline (or equivalent experience)</li> <li>Significant sales experience</li> <li>Proven track record of exceeding quota and KPIs</li> <li>Background in enterprise software, SaaS, or cloud organizations</li> </ul> <p title: Creative Strategy Director
description: <p><em>DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention services across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Meta, eBay, and OpenAI. We have been certified B Corp and Climate Neutral since 2021.</em></p> <p><strong><br></strong><strong>JOB PURPOSE</strong></p> <p><em>This position is based in London. We combine data, technology, creative content, and paid media to crack brands’ business problems and drive revenue through a variety of digital marketing solutions, from advertising campaigns to augmented reality and chatbots. Our clients include eBay, INEOS, Mammut, Easyjet, PepsiCo, Loreal and Logitech.</em></p> <p>Creative Strategy Directors at DEPT® are at the heart of growth invention, bringing together brilliant strategic craft, creative thinking, cultural understanding, and a broader perspective on business and technology. We’re looking for someone who has mastered the fundamentals of strategy but isn’t interested in playing by the old rules. Someone shaped by the world's most renowned creative agencies, with the experience and instinct to challenge convention, connect disciplines, and help define what modern marketing looks like.</p> <p>We believe great strategy is less about following frameworks and more about asking the right questions, finding unexpected connections, and creating the conditions for brilliant work. The playing field is bigger than advertising. It spans culture, commerce, creativity, media, technology, communities, and the ambitions of our clients. We need someone who sees opportunity in all of it.</p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU'LL DO</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Define the real challenge:</strong> Get under the skin of our clients' businesses, their audiences, and the world around them. Connect the dots across culture, commerce, company, competition, capability, community, and creative ambition to uncover the opportunities others might miss.</li> <li><strong>Find the tension:</strong> Turn complexity into clarity. Find the sharpest insights, the most interesting tensions, and the questions that unlock new possibilities for brands and businesses.</li> <li><strong>Craft the springboard:</strong> Develop strategic briefs, provocations, narratives, and thought-starters that inspire creative teams, give ideas direction, and make brilliant work possible.</li> <li><strong>Invent growth:</strong> Look beyond the brief and beyond the boundaries of traditional marketing. Identify new opportunities for clients, connect disciplines, and help shape bigger, more ambitious growth challenges.</li> <li><strong>Think horizontally:</strong> Move comfortably across brand, creative, social, digital, media, technology, and experience. You don't need to be an expert in everything, but you know how to connect the dots and bring the right people together.</li> <li><strong>Embrace what's next:</strong> Explore how emerging technologies, AI, and the evolving roles of humans and agents are reshaping customer journeys, business operations, and the opportunities for our clients.</li> <li><strong>Move at pace:</strong> Be comfortable with ambiguity, trust your instincts, and get hands-on. You know when to dig deeper, when to challenge the obvious, and when to get a good idea out into the world.</li> <li><strong>Elevate the floor:</strong> Bring your experience, point of view, and curiosity to the wider team. Challenge the thinking, inspire the people around you, and help make the work (and the people around you) better.</li> </ul> <p>That's the core of it. Beyond that, we're looking for someone who cares deeply about the craft of strategy, the power of creativity, and the potential of people and businesses. Someone with a point of view, a healthy disregard for convention, and the energy to help build something new.</p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU'LL BRING</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Strategic craft:</strong> 10+ years of experience, ideally gained in leading creative agencies. You have strong foundations in brand and creative strategy, and the work to show for it.</li> <li><strong>Creative instinct:</strong> You know what makes an idea interesting, unexpected, and powerful. You can spot the potential in a thought and help turn it into work people care about.</li> <li><strong>A broader horizon:</strong> You're as interested in what happens beyond advertising as you are in advertising itself. Social, digital, media, technology, business, culture: it's all part of the picture.</li> <li><strong>Connected thinking:</strong> You don't think in silos. You connect the dots between audience, brand, business, culture, competition, capability, and creativity to find opportunities for growth.</li> <li><strong>Cultural fluency:</strong> You have a deep understanding of British (advertising) culture and an instinct for what's shifting in the world around us. You're curious about people, platforms, movements, and the things shaping what comes next.</li> <li><strong>An appetite for what's next:</strong> You’re interested in how AI, new technologies, and changing behaviours are creating new opportunities for brands and businesses. You're willing to explore, experiment, and challenge your own thinking.</li> <li><strong>Entrepreneurial spirit:</strong> You're not waiting for the perfect brief or the next big assignment. You spot opportunities, make things happen, and bring energy to building something new.</li> <li><strong>A point of view:</strong> You have your own perspective on strategy, creativity, and the industry. You're confident enough to challenge convention, open enough to change your mind, and curious enough to keep learning.</li> <li><strong>Hands-on leadership:</strong> You lead through the work. You're as comfortable getting stuck into a brief, shaping a thought, or working alongside a creative team as you are guiding a room or presenting a bigger vision.</li> <li><strong>Team player:</strong> You know the best work comes from bringing people together. You collaborate generously, challenge constructively, and leave egos at the door. You're interested in bigger challenges, not bigger titles.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>WE OFFER</strong></p> <ul> <li>A flexible, hybrid working policy (2-3 days from the office, depending on location) and the opportunity to work from abroad for 13 weeks a year.</li> <li>24 vacation days per year and the possibility to buy an unlimited number of extra vacation days.</li> <li>DEPT®/YOU Learning Menu and DEPT®/YOU Special Programs. Develop your skills with courses and programs tailored to your needs.</li> <li>Stay happy and healthy with a contribution to your health through the OpenUp platform, gym and wellness discounts, and healthy lunches at the office.</li> <li>Get a discount on your lease bike and ride in style. You can also enjoy hassle free-commutes with an NS Business Card.</li> <li>A reputation for doing good. DEPT® has been a Certified B Corp® since 2021, has been named a<a href="https://www.greatplacetowork.nl/en/certification/certified/dept"> Great Place To Work since 2022</a> in the Netherlands and named ‘Agency of the Year’ at both The Lovies and The Webby Awards.</li> <li>Awesome clients. Whether big, small, local or global — at DEPT® you’ll get the opportunity to work with all of them. And we celebrate all of our successes together!</li> <li>You can discover even more employee benefits<a href="https://www.deptagency.com/nl-nl/employee-benefits/"> here</a>.</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHY DEPT®?</strong></p> <p>We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.</p> <p>We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.</p> <p>At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.</p> <p><strong>DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION </strong></p> <p>At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.</p> <p>Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.</p> <p>We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.</p> <p>Want to know more about our dedication to diversity, equity, and inclusion? Check out our efforts<a href="https://www.deptagency.com/the-good-company/"> here</a>.</p> <p> </p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

With over 200 million athletes in more than 185 countries, it’s more than tracking workouts—it’s where people make progress together, from new habits to new personal bests. No matter your sport or how you track it, Strava’s got you covered. Find your crew, crush your goals, and make every effort count. Start your journey with Strava today. Our mission is simple: to motivate people to live their best active lives. We believe in the power of movement to connect and drive people forward. This role is on the Strava Security Team, which exists to protect Strava’s people, business, and data through integrated, proactive security practices. We work across all security domains, including, but not limited to, product security, vulnerability management, incident response, infrastructure, network, and enterprise security. We follow a flexible hybrid model that generally translates to around half your time on-site in our London office – three days per week. What You’ll Do: Protect the Runna and Strava platforms that support millions of athletes by ensuring applications and infrastructure are secure, resilient, and compliant across regions. Work closely with engineering, infrastructure, and security teams to design and implement secure architectures and development practices. Make a high-leverage impact by shaping how Strava manages application and infrastructure risks in the US and EU, ensuring speed, accuracy, and consistency in remediation. Build automated workflows that identify vulnerabilities early, enforce secure configurations, and strengthen our CI/CD and cloud security controls. You Will Be Successful Here By: Being highly self-motivated and detail-oriented, with a strong sense of ownership for Strava’s application, infrastructure, and network security posture. Driving secure-by-design practices across engineering teams, including threat modeling, architecture reviews, and vulnerability management. Embracing the usefulness of generative AI tools and applying them to your daily work. Partnering with Engineering and Infrastructure teams to embed automated security checks into CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code deployments. Coordinating incident response, vulnerability triage, and remediation validation in partnership with the global security team. title: Staff Product Manager
description: What we're building Jiga is on a mission to help engineers build physical products faster. The problem: engineers designing physical products waste weeks chasing quotes, vetting suppliers, and managing procurement instead of actually engineering. Jiga fixes this by connecting engineers directly with vetted manufacturers (CNC, sheet metal, injection molding, 3D printing). Think "npm install for mechanical engineers" - get the parts you need without the admin nightmare. We're a small, fully-funded, cashflow-positive team serving enterprise customers like NASA, Google, Tesla, and Apple. The role We're looking for an execution-focused, zero-fluff Staff Product Manager. Someone who can take ownership and drive product initiatives with a high degree of autonomy. You'll be making calls on what we build and why, translating messy customer and operational problems into simple solutions, and making sure they're executed well, monitored, and improved over time. How we actually work We’re a small remote team made up of the best of the best. Our team members are distributed around the globe, with product and engineering talent across Europe, Israel, and the US. You’ll also work with teammates in Asia. Most of our work happens async, which is the secret sauce of our success. High trust, low bullshit: We don't count hours or peek over your shoulder on Slack. We trust you to get your work done and tell us when something's wrong. You'll have real ownership over what you build, no process theater, no busy-work meetings. Question everything: See something that doesn't make sense? Say it. Have a better way to do something? Just do it. We actually mean it when we say we want people to challenge the status quo and improve things. Our internal motto is “Don’t drink the kool-aid.” No busy work, no fluff: We keep processes lightweight and practical. If something helps us work better or solve a real problem, we do it. If it creates work without adding value, we question it. Actually friendly, not corporate friendly: We play games online every week (current favorite: Make it Meme). Once a year we fly everyone somewhere beautiful for our offsite. We genuinely like hanging out together, which turns out to be way better than forced "team building exercises." What we value in product and engineering: Simple > Complicated. Simple code, simple architecture. Simple solutions are better than complex ones. Ship it, then improve it. Perfection is the enemy of done. Launch now, iterate forever. Product > Engineering. Every line of code should make our users' lives better. We're not here to show off our algorithmic prowess - we're here to solve real business problems. Financials Jiga is fully funded, cashflow positive, with growing revenue MoM. We're completely transparent about our runway and finances - ask us anything. What you'll actually do Talk to customers and suppliers, and work closely with internal users to understand their workflows and pain points (not just read reports about them). Go deep into a complex problem and come back with a simple solution. Analyze and monitor product usage data yourself to inform decisions and measure results. Define what we build next and why, then write specs engineers can actually execute on. Work closely with engineering and design to take solutions through delivery, follow up after launch, and improve what isn’t working. Collaborate with sales, CS, and operations to understand business needs and improve internal processes. Take ownership and move things forward independently without exhausting approval loops. Clearly communicate what we’re not focusing on and why. Use AI throughout all of the above to move faster, go deeper, and get more done. What we're looking for Must have: You've built meaningful products that people use and that drive business results. 5+ years in product, including experience owning complex initiatives independently. Startup experience (<50 people). You know what “do everything” means. Actually hands-on: you've done user research, written specs, built prototypes, and prioritized backlogs yourself. Recently. Not five years ago before you “moved to strategy.” Comfortable with data, dashboards, and product analytics. You ask the right questions, find the answers yourself, and question what the numbers are telling you. You know what moves the needle, focus on that, and separate real problems from noise. You go deep with engineers, communicate clearly in writing, keep stakeholders aligned, and ask users questions that uncover real needs. You're willing and able to get into operational details, work with internal teams, and improve how things get done. You use AI hands-on in your daily work and have experience building AI-powered features that deliver real value within users’ workflows. Strong UI/UX instincts. You have opinions about the details. At least 4 hours of overlap with GMT+3 working hours. Nice to have: A background in industrial design, mechanical engineering, or supply chain. Hands-on experience as a software engineer, data analyst, or UI/UX designer. B2B experience in collaboration tools, quoting, supply chain, manufacturing, CAD, logistics, or marketplaces. You'll love it here if You're energized by ambiguity, not paralyzed by it. "Figure it out" sounds like freedom, not abandonment. You have strong opinions loosely held. You're decisive but update quickly when you're wrong. You're low-ego, high-output. You do the grunt work, not just the strategy decks. You see gaps and fill them without being asked. You say what you think. No corporate speak, no hedging, no "let's circle back." "If I can solve this without pulling in a dev, I'll just do it" is how you operate. You're obsessively curious about manufacturing and how things get made. This might not be for you if You need meetings to get things moving. You prefer clear requirements handed to you. You like building consensus before making any decision. "Move fast and break things" gives you anxiety. You want to focus on "strategy" and have someone else handle the details. You can’t operate without a clear process and hierarchy. What we offer A small team where you matter: We never compromise on people. That means you are part of the best team in the world. Zero bureaucracy: We hate process theatre as much as you do. Real ownership and responsibility: Make decisions, ship solutions, own the outcomes. Complete flexibility: Work from anywhere, set your own hours, take time off when you need it (parents especially welcome). Genuinely high trust: We trust you to do great work and be honest when things go sideways. A team that actually likes each other: International, diverse, genuinely friendly people who enjoy working together. Generous stock options: Meaningful equity in the company you’re helping build. Self-development budget for books, courses, conferences, whatever helps you grow. Annual offsites in beautiful places. Fast-paced environment with tons of creative freedom. Hard, interesting problems with a team that's positioned to win big . How to apply Tell us about a product decision you made that was controversial at the time but turned out right. title: Product Manager
description: About Kernel Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this? Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier. Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust. Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent Kernel ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. We have strong product-market fit: Ops, data, and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva, and Checkout already use Kernel across their enterprise systems. title: Lead Product Data Scientist
description: About Zego 🚀 At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing. Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive. We're not just updating insurance; We're leading the AI evolution in insurance 🤖 For us, AI isn't a line on a roadmap or a buzzword on a slide. It's our operating reality, and it's how we build products that back drivers instead of the old insurance playbook. We don't do things slowly, and we don't do bureaucracy. We back high-performance builders who want ownership, early responsibility and the chance to do the most career-defining work of their lives. You'll get the space to try things, the tools to move fast, and the room to see your ideas reach millions of drivers. Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor . If you're ready to build the future of insurance, we're hiring. About the team Zego’s Data team delivers high-impact projects across the whole business - from AI tools that let anyone query data and publish dashboards in Zego Lens, to the customer insights that shape our growth strategy. We already have established data science teams in Pricing and Telematics. This is the first data science role in our central Data team, focused on the huge untapped potential across the rest of the business - from experimentation to churn, marketing and fraud. We’re a fast-moving disruptor in insurance, driven by great tech products and data. We adopt new technology quickly - we’re AI-first, so most of our code is now written by AI and reviewed by people. About the role As our first Lead Product Data Scientist, you’ll shape how Zego makes its biggest product and commercial decisions. You’ll work directly with senior leaders across Product, Growth and Operations to decide where to focus, which bets to back and how we’ll know they’ve worked. You’ll start by building the foundations - a trusted experimentation framework and customer models that tell us who to acquire, how to engage them and where to invest. As teams learn to run routine experiments themselves, your focus will shift to guiding product investment and making sure evidence, rather than intuition, drives our roadmap. This is a senior, hands-on role with real scope to shape a new capability - and the chance to use AI to scale data science across a growing business. What you will be doing Work with senior leaders to embed data science in strategy and decision making. Create and own a prioritised roadmap for where data science can have the biggest impact. Own Zego’s experimentation framework - design standards, power, guardrail metrics and decision rules. Coach teams to run routine experiments themselves. Partner with Product teams before anything is built, shaping ideas into evidence-based hypotheses and well-designed experiments. Apply causal inference where randomised tests aren’t possible. Build models of customer behaviour across the lifecycle - acquisition, conversion, retention, churn and lifetime value - with teams such as Marketing and Fraud. Use AI to scale data science across Zego, automating experiment analysis and readouts. Build self-serve tools that help teams sharpen their hypotheses. Take the most impactful models into production with our ML Platform team. Set technical direction and mentor analysts and data scientists as the capability grows. What you’ll need Significant data science experience in a product-led business, with a track record of work that changed product or commercial decisions. Strong executive presence - you influence senior leaders, challenge decisions with evidence and explain results clearly to any audience. Expertise in experimentation and causal inference, with many online experiments designed and analysed. Experience building customer models such as churn, propensity, LTV or segmentation - and getting them used in real decisions. Strong Python and SQL, with confidence working AI-first (and the judgement to spot when AI output is wrong). Experience taking models into production on AWS SageMaker or a similar ML platform. Nice to have Familiarity with experimentation or product analytics platforms such as Statsig or Amplitude. Experience with Snowflake, dbt and Looker or a similar modern data stack. Experience of marketing measurement such as media mix modelling or incrementality testing. A background in insurance, fintech or another regulated or subscription business. The Zego ways of working 🏡 Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid: some of us are in our office (central London, Gibraltar or Halifax) weekly, others monthly or quarterly. It's about finding the balance between face time and focus that produces great work and a healthy life around it. We also make a point of getting everyone in the same room. Teams come together every quarter, and once a year the whole company does, properly. It's a serious investment and consistently one of the best parts of the year. Here is what the last one looked like . Benefits 🎁 💰 Market-competitive salary, benchmarked against your function and reviewed every year. 🏆 Annual performance bonus, linked to company performance and your contribution. 📈 Share options, a real stake in the company and a share in the future you build 🩺 Private medical insurance. 🏖️ Pension, generous holiday, and £1,000 a year to spend on getting to the office or learning something new. 💻 Cutting-edge systems and tools, so you always have what you need to drive your impact. Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? We want to hear from you. Zego, leading the AI evolution in insurance. Equal opportunities 🌈 We're an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status. title: Risk and Controls Operations Associate
description: Risk and Controls Operations Associate Office Location: Temple, London - hybrid working environment (3 days in office per week) Reporting: Chief Operating Officer About Investa Investa is building the UK’s first zero-commission Options and Stocks trading platform. Legacy platforms typically feature high fees and complex interfaces that cut out the majority of retail investors. We are building a streamlined alternative to fix that. Investa is the first FCA-regulated platform to offer completely free US share trading with no FX, no commission, and no other fees. Our Traction So Far: £3.5M+ raised in funding with 1,000+ shareholders backing our vision FCA-regulated and multi-award winning in 2026: Best Options Trading App (Good Money Guide) & Best App for Options Trading (ADVFN) Available on iOS and Android, scaling rapidly toward our next milestones of 10,000 and 100,000 active users 8,000+ trades processed, 2,500+ early supporters rewarded, and 150+ 5-star reviews Our Mission: To democratise options trading for UK investors Our Vision: Think Options, Think Investa We are a lean, agile team where every employee directly shapes the business. We don't have a corporate way of working. Instead, we look for people who want high autonomy, care about making a visible impact, and align with our core values of being Collaborative, Curious, and Creative. We are growing and looking for ambitious talent to help us democratise retail investing across the UK. The Role As our Risk & Controls Operations Associate, you will serve as the first line of regulatory and operational control for Investa’s platform. Working together with our Head of Risk & Compliance and Co-Founders, you will help own the day-to-day execution of our key operational controls spanning CASS oversight, onboarding operations, financial crime monitoring, and execution control. This is a critical, high-visibility role within a fast-scaling financial trading environment. You will bridge regulatory oversight with practical execution: verifying client money flows, resolving dealing and onboarding exceptions, and ensuring our operations adhere strictly to FCA standards as our operating model expands from sub-account clearing into in-house custody and scales UK retail options trading. Rather than running a static checklist, you'll help build and refine our operational controls and CASS processes as we launch new products. What the role involves 1. Risk & Control Operations CASS Reconciliations: Perform daily internal & external CASS reconciliations across Investa’s client base to prevent breaches and ensure compliance with day-to-day CASS obligations. CASS Reporting & Audits: Maintain audit-ready compliance records, log breaks and CASS breaches, and assist in preparing regulatory returns and notifications when needed. KYC & Onboarding Operations: Own the day-to-day onboarding queue, performing KYC/AML document reviews, appropriateness assessments, and managing PEPs, sanctions, and high-risk escalations. Financial Crime Monitoring: Organise high-risk client reviews assisting with enhanced due diligence, source of funds/wealth checks, and periodic and event driven reviews. Vulnerable Customer Framework: Manage sensitive customer cases as identified in the vulnerable clients policy, ensure good outcomes for clients with support needs, manage key performance indicators for clients in this segment in strict compliance with Consumer Duty standards and internal policies. 2. Business Oversight & Governance Support Management Information: Own and gather key performance indicators covering all aspects of the business for committee reporting and oversight. Financial Promotions: Review and approve marketing campaigns, product copy, and social media promotions to ensure strict alignment with FCA Financial Promotion and Consumer Duty rules. Regulatory Change: Assist in implementation of regulatory change in the UK or elsewhere to ensure compliance with new rules that apply to the Firm. Third Party Risk Management: Point of contact for vendors and outsourcing partners to oversee and coordinate information sharing for incident closure & customer support. Trade surveillance: Provide first line review of alerts generated through trade surveillance for signs of market abuse. Oversee the closure of alerts and applicable audit trail. Your Background 2+ years of hands-on experience covering trade operations or controls support at a regulated firm, FinTech, investment platform, or broker. Understanding of the regulatory framework surrounding CASS, Consumer Duty, Systems & Controls, and Anti-Money Laundering. Direct experience executing CASS reconciliation workflows, client adoption, and trade surveillance. Strong analytical mindset with high attention to detail and sound, practical judgement. Technical proficiency in Office and Google-based software including excel, Google Sheets, Google Docs. Desirable Prior exposure to retail investment platforms, derivatives markets. Experience using workflow tools like Jira or case management software. Familiarity with third-party clearing integrations (e.g., Interactive Brokers) or regulatory reporting tools. CISI or equivalent qualification regarding financial services, client assets, or regulatory modules. Understanding of EU regulation. What we offer Career Ownership & Impact: You have autonomy over your execution and your career trajectory. Your work impacts the business immediately without corporate red tape. You can choose whether you want to pave a path as a high-level individual contributor or step into management as we scale - you shape your career. Collaboration & Proximity: You work alongside our co-founders. Because of our size, our culture is extremely personal. Everyone has firsthand insight into top-level strategy, cross-departmental exposure, and a voice in the product journey. Creativity & Speed: We prioritise innovation through speed, agility, thinking outside the box, and resource-efficient solutions. Shared Success & Equity: We are in this together. To ensure everyone benefits from our growth, every employee receives meaningful company equity. Our success is your success. Compensation and Benefits Financial Growth 💸 Competitive base salary - depending on experience. Equity: Initial grant of 0.1% - 0.15% in stock options. We reward impact with additional performance-based grants and milestone-linked top-ups. Annual Review: Structured salary and performance reviews conducted every year to ensure your growth stays on track. Health & Wellbeing 🌴🦷 Annual Leave: 30 days (including bank holidays) + your birthday off. Premium Coverage: Private medical and dental insurance via Bupa. Office Environment & Lifestyle ☕ The Office: Work from a vibrant, spacious office featuring a private gym and a rooftop terrace for fresh-air breaks. Fuel & Socials: Enjoy tea, coffee and snacks daily. Every last Wednesday of the month, we host a Team Lunch where the menu is chosen by the staff. We also run regular team socials, alongside company and individual milestone celebrations. Tech 💻 Custom Setup: You’ll receive a high-spec MacBook and £150 toward a mouse and keyboard of your choice. A recommendation on whether and where machine learning fits, with a design for it: what it predicts, the signals it draws on, and how it is measured. Build sits with engineering. The metrics that matter, how we measure detection accuracy, and the guardrails that keep them honest. Clear recommendations on the questions we are wrestling with, including where to set the burden of proof for eligibility. This role is a perfect match for you if you have: 5-7 years in a fraud or risk role, ideally in payments, fintech, marketplaces, or identity verification. Deep knowledge of fraud typologies and how fraud rings form, adapt, and shift tactics over time. A track record of setting risk appetite, detection thresholds, and review policies in a live environment, and keeping them current. Strong judgement on the balance between catching fraud and protecting the experience of genuine users. Enough technical fluency to work closely with engineers and know what's realistic to build. Comfort working from data: able to interrogate detection metrics, false positives and negatives, and draw defensible conclusions. Bonus if you have knowledge or love of: Experience in education, nonprofit, or grant verification, or another domain with institutional eligibility checks. Familiarity with domain and email-based fraud signals, such as institution impersonation and disposable or pseudo-official domains. Hands-on exposure to fraud tooling and vendors, such as identity verification, device fingerprinting, or domain reputation services. It's a warm, friendly space right in the heart of London 🙌 … and so much more About us Since 2017, Goodstack has been at the forefront of creating a future where good will be built into everything we do. From daily commutes to weekend activities or grocery shopping, we envision a world where creating positive change is seamlessly integrated into our everyday lives. In this future, the depth and breadth of impact we can make through everyday actions will expand dramatically – benefiting both businesses and the world. Businesses are expected to deliver on both profit and purpose and those that don’t are falling behind. We’re here to make it easy for any company, anywhere in the world, to integrate good into what they do. Doing this empowers everyone – companies, employees, consumers, and communities – to contribute to positive change and take meaningful action. Let's do this! 💜 OUR PLEDGE TO DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION We take pride in our diverse and growing team representing 20+ nationalities across 5 continents 🌍! title: Assistant Controller
description: About MUBI MUBI is a global streaming service, production company and film distributor dedicated to elevating great cinema. To make this possible, we create, curate, acquire and champion visionary films, bringing them to audiences all over the world. About the Role MUBI is looking for an Assistant Controller to lead our group accounting and financial reporting function from London. Reporting to the Global Controller, you will own the US GAAP close and consolidation, lead group financial reporting and the day-to-day delivery of our Big Four group audit, and oversee statutory accounting across our international entities. You will directly manage our senior statutory accounting leads. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will stay close enough to the detail to resolve issues and set a high bar for accuracy, while also developing the team, strengthening controls and improving how we close, report and operate. Your initial mandate is focused on group and statutory accounting. Cash and treasury operations and payroll will initially remain outside your remit. Once the core accounting mandate is firmly established, we expect the role to broaden over time to include greater oversight of cash and treasury. We are therefore looking for someone who already brings meaningful experience in these areas. You will work closely with the Global Controller on complex accounting matters, systems and automation, controls and the continued development of the function. MUBI's accounting environment spans subscription streaming, film distribution and production across multiple entities, countries and currencies. We are looking for someone who learned the fundamentals in Big Four audit and has since applied them in-house, with the judgement and experience to operate effectively across this complexity as the business continues to grow. We work hybrid-remote where we require 3 office days in London. Our core days are Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday, with the flexibility to use our offices on the remaining two days if you wish. Where you’ll have impact: Own the close and consolidation. Lead the month-, quarter- and year-end close and consolidation process across all entities, including review of journal entries, accruals, reconciliations, eliminations and other key close outputs. Lead financial reporting. Prepare and review consolidated US GAAP financial statements, management reporting packs and supporting schedules, ensuring group reporting is accurate, timely and well supported. Own key accounting areas. Oversee accounting for content assets, subscription and distribution revenue, deferred revenue, partner and app-store settlements, intercompany balances and foreign currency. Work with FP&A, content and other teams where accounting depends on operational data or business context. Oversee global statutory accounting. Directly manage our senior statutory accounting leads and coordinate statutory reporting across the group, working with local teams and external advisers to ensure statutory accounts and filings are complete, accurate and delivered on time. Lead the audit. Manage the day-to-day delivery of the Big Four group audit and coordinate statutory audits across our entities. Build an effective relationship with our auditors and advisers and ensure requests and deliverables are well supported and resolved promptly. Strengthen controls and processes. Document and improve accounting processes and SOPs, strengthen key close and reporting controls, and help develop the control environment toward public-company and SOX standards. Partner on technical accounting. Work with the Global Controller and external advisers on new or complex accounting matters, helping translate technical conclusions into clear accounting policies and treatment. Improve systems and automation. Lead improvements to our accounting systems, close and reporting workflows. Use automation and AI where they can materially improve accuracy, speed and efficiency. What you’ll bring: Active US CPA licence. You hold an active US CPA licence and bring strong practical knowledge of US GAAP. Big Four and in-house experience. You have at least eight years of accounting experience, including meaningful Big Four audit experience and at least two years in an in-house accounting role, ideally within a complex, multi-entity international business. Close and consolidation expertise. You have owned or played a senior role in month-, quarter- and year-end close and group consolidation, including the preparation or review of financial statements, with a strong understanding of the GL and end-to-end financial reporting process. Strong people leadership. You have at least three years of experience managing and developing accounting professionals and are comfortable leading experienced team members across different countries and areas of responsibility. Audit and controls experience. You have acted as a senior company-side contact for external auditors and have experience documenting, operating and improving internal financial controls. International statutory experience. You have overseen statutory accounting and reporting across multiple jurisdictions and know how to work effectively with local finance teams, advisers and auditors without needing to be the technical expert in every market. Meaningful cash and treasury experience. You have practical experience with the core disciplines of cash and treasury in a multi-entity business, including cash reporting or forecasting, banking operations, payment controls and bank reconciliations. Strong systems and process capability. You have experience with NetSuite, Ramp and other finance and accounting systems, plus advanced Excel skills. Clear judgement and communication. You have strong attention to detail, can move comfortably between accounting detail and the wider business context, communicate clearly with senior stakeholders, and manage competing priorities under tight deadlines. You have the right to work in the UK and are able to work in person from our London office. We want to make cinema accessible to everyone. We believe people from different backgrounds bring different ideas that foster innovation and engagement, allowing us to attract great people to develop the best experience for our users. Our mission is to turn every interaction between a brand and its customers into a relationship: personal, seamless, and intelligent. You've found and fixed exploitable bugs in software you were responsible for, through threat modelling, secure design, code review, and proof-of-concept exploitation across web services, APIs, and data-serving interfaces. You know tenant isolation, IAM and least privilege, secrets management, Kubernetes and container security, and the trust boundaries between services Daily use of frontier AI models for code analysis, vulnerability triage, remediation drafting, and research, with sharp judgement about where they're reliable and where they mislead. You know which designs need deep review, which findings matter and which are noise, and you make accepted risk explicit so leadership can decide with open eyes Clear communication. You explain risk and trade-offs precisely to engineers, product, and leadership, write guidance people actually use, and mentor others to grow security capability across teams Your Package We are committed to providing a transparent, supportive, and rewarding work environment. There are many interesting challenges ahead, and we're happy for people to move between teams or to specialise, whatever you prefer. As an engineer here you'd be able to work directly with anyone across the company, and we run regular knowledge-sharing sessions so you’ll learn heaps about everything from how banks work to effective communication.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We contribute to </span><a href="https://github.com/monzo"><strong>open source software</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> as much as possible. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond.
